message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
for N in [1,2,4,8,14,15]:
 prefix=bytes(range(1,N+1))
 token=(min(N,15)<<4)|0
 extra=b''
 if N>=15: extra=b'\x00'
 s=bytes([token])+extra+prefix+b'\x00\x00'+b'\x00'
 out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*64,64); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),N+4,64)
 print(N,s.hex(),r,out.raw[:r+4].hex())
PY
